role.zh: 聯合創辦人｜修顏社小顏術創辦人｜日本小顏矯正認定協會認證導師

bio.en:
Teresa is the co-founder of Shugaosha and the Australian Representative of the Japan Small Face Correction Association.

After completing advanced training in Japan, she became a certified trainer and developed The Shugaosha Way—a gentle hands-on approach that helps restore natural facial balance for a more lifted, firmer and harmonious appearance.

With years of clinical experience and continued education, Teresa has helped over 2,000 clients achieve natural-looking results while training the next generation of practitioners.
bio.zh:
Teresa 是 Shugaosha 的聯合創辦人及日本小顏矯正協會的澳洲代表。

在日本完成進階培訓後，她成為認證導師，並創立了「修顏社小顏術」（The Shugaosha Way）——一種溫和的徒手調整手法，幫助恢復自然的面部平衡，塑造更加提升、緊緻且和諧的面容。

憑藉多年的臨床經驗和持續深造，Teresa 已幫助超過 2,000 位客戶獲得自然平衡的效果，同時致力於培訓新一代的小顏矯正師。

role.zh: 聯合創辦人｜修顏社小顏術共同創辦人｜認證小顏矯正師

bio.en:
Charles is the co-founder of Shugaosha and a certified specialist dedicated to restoring natural facial balance through gentle Japanese hands-on techniques.

Known for his calm and meticulous approach, Charles tailors every treatment to each individual’s facial structure, helping clients achieve a more lifted, firmer and naturally balanced appearance.

With years of hands-on experience, Charles has helped over a thousand clients achieve natural-looking results while continuing to refine The Shugaosha Way.
bio.zh:
Charles 是 Shugaosha 的聯合創辦人，也是一名認證小顏矯正師，致力於透過溫和的日式徒手手法恢復自然的面部平衡。

Charles 以溫和、細緻的手法著稱，針對每位客人的個人面部結構精心調整，幫助客戶實現更加提升、緊緻且自然對稱的面容。

憑藉多年的實踐經驗，Charles 已幫助上千位客戶獲得自然的效果，同時不斷完善與精進「修顏社小顏術」。
